htn_kidney.title: Study of the histology of nonneoplastic kidney diseases in nephrectomies and nephroureterectomies performed for tumors.
htn_kidney.authors: Ahmed NM, Anuradha SVN, Gowrishankar S
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：该英文报道关注最新动态：Nephrectomies performed for tumors may harbor nonneoplastic kidney diseases and ... 临床提示：该英文报道关注最新动态：Careful histological assessment of the uninvolved renal parenchyma using light m...
htn_kidney.abstract: Nephrectomies performed for tumors may harbor nonneoplastic kidney diseases and influence patient outcomes; hence, studying the uninvolved portion of the renal parenchyma at the time of histological tumor diagnosis is prudent. Careful histological assessment of the uninvolved renal parenchyma using light microscopy, special stains and immunofluorescence study gives valuable information regarding pre-existing renal damage. This cross-sectional observational study evaluated 151 partial and radical nephrectomies and nephroureterectomies performed for tumors. portal_hypertension.abstract: Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis (SBP) is a life-threatening cirrhosis complication, yet guidance for sending fluid studies from outpatient paracentesis remains limited with unclear clinical impact. We aimed to characterize variation in ascitic fluid testing practices during outpatient paracentesis in cirrhosis and evaluate its association with short-term hospitalization and mortality. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 60,619 outpatient paracenteses among 4,467 patients with cirrhosis in the Veterans Health Administration from 2012-2023.
